decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two storey side and rear extensions on this prominent due to their size, scale, position, and appearance would not be in keeping with the style and character of the house, and would not be proportionate with the terrace of which it forms part, which would be harmful to the appearance of the area.  This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and supplementary guidance for Residential Extension Guidelines, of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed two storey part of the rear extension due to it's size, scale, and position, would be harmful to neighbours' living conditions at 69, 73 and 77 through loss of daylight, outlook, and increased sense of enclosure.  This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and supplementary guidance for Residential Extension Guidelines, of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two storey side and part two storey and single storey rear extension to house.
